description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'DeviceTokenScreen' that displays the Firebase Cloud Messaging device token, allows the user to refresh it, and copy it to clipboard.

classes.name: DeviceTokenScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that shows the device's FCM token, with options to refresh and copy it.

classes.name: _DeviceTokenScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and UI for DeviceTokenScreen, including token loading, error handling, and user interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, triggering the token load process.

methods.name: _loadToken
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the device token from Firebase Messaging Service, handling errors and updating UI state.

methods.name: _copyToken
methods.description: Copies the current device token to the clipboard and triggers a snackbar message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the screen, displaying token info, loading indicators, error messages, and action buttons.
